name: Brute
flavor: You are a raging bull, powering through everything holding you back.
abilities: When you Bleed, you discard up to 6 Status Tokens you hold.
Once per turn, after you move into an obstacle's space, destroy all obstacles in that space and ignore their effects.

name: Cryptid
flavor: You are a myth, a rumor, a fairy tale. Were you ever even there?
abilities: At the start of each Round and when you Bleed, you may place Fog into your space or an adjacent space.

name: Fool
flavor: You're always in a hurry, scrambling directly into (or away from) trouble.
abilities: At the start of each Round and when you Bleed, you may Move 3.

name: Freak
flavor: Your body is strange and unnatural, and your movements are difficult to follow.
abilities: When you Bleed, you may Pull yourself 2 towards an enemy you can see, then give 3 Fatigue tokens to an enemy within range.

name: Grim
flavor: You always expect the worst, and you intend to survive it.
abilities: When you Bleed, you gain temporary Armor.
Once per turn, after your Armor was triggered by an enemy Action, you may Push 2 to that enemy.

name: Guardian
flavor: You are a devoted defender, keeping your allies safe at any cost.
abilities: When you Bleed, up to three allies you can see each gain 1 Iron token. You may pay HP equal to the Heal Value to give them each 2 Iron Tokens instead.

name: Hero
flavor: Your inspiring presence invigorates allies when they see you come to their aid.
abilities: When you Bleed, you and one ally you can see each gain Shield 2.

name: Leader
flavor: Your minions follow you wherever you go, and snatch you away from danger.
abilities: At the start of each Round, you may place up to 2 Copies into empty spaces within Range.
When you Bleed, place a Copy within range, then teleport into an empty space adjacent to one of your Copies that you can see.

name: Lightfoot
flavor: You have boundless stamina, quickly and easily hopping along terrain.
abilities: At the start of each Round and when you Bleed, you gain 2 Speed tokens and may Move 1.

name: Monster
flavor: You are a vicious villain who shows no remorse, a devil in disguise.
abilities: When you Bleed, give 3 Burning tokens to the enemy that made you Bleed. If this was triggered by damage that was not dealt by an enemy, give these Burning tokens to an enemy you can see.

name: Powerhouse
flavor: You are strong. That is all that you need. The world crumbles around you.
abilities: When you Bleed, you gain 2 Power tokens.
At the start of each Round, you may place Rubble within range.

name: Rat
flavor: You play dirty and are willing to use cheap, unfair methods to win.
abilities: At the start of each Round, you may place a Trap within range.
When you Bleed, you may place a Pit into an adjacent space.

name: Scarred
flavor: You have had a difficult life, and it shows.
abilities: At the start of each Round, you give 1 Weakness token to up to two enemies you can see.
When you Bleed, give 1 Weakness token to each enemy you can see.

name: Temple
flavor: Your body is your god, the basis of your worship, and you maintain it well.
abilities: When you Bleed, you heal.
Your first Health Bar has additional HP equal to the Bleed Value.
